verses.raw: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
verses.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].

verses.raw: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
verses.text: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
